description: This is a test class for the CreditAllocationsJsonParser, focusing on parsing JSON data related to credit allocations for loan products, including testing empty JSON input and parsing specific credit allocation rules.

classes.name: CreditAllocationsJsonParserTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying the parsing logic and validation of credit allocation JSON data within loan products.

methods.name: testEmptyJson
methods.description: Tests the parsing of an empty JSON object for credit allocations, ensuring no rules are returned and validation is called properly.

methods.name: testParseSingleChargebackAllocation
methods.description: Tests the parsing of a JSON object containing a single credit allocation of type CHARGEBACK, verifying correct parsing and validation calls.

methods.name: createCreditAllocationEntry
methods.description: Helper method to create a map representing a credit allocation entry with a transaction type and ordered rules.

methods.name: createJsonCommand
methods.description: Helper method to convert a JSON map into a JsonCommand instance for testing.
